The Property
A three-bedroom semi-detached home with a driveway, generous rear garden and scope to make it your own, set in a popular residential area of Fallowfield.

If you’re looking for a home with plenty of potential, this could be a great place to start. The property offers a good-sized living room, kitchen, downstairs WC and three bedrooms upstairs.

The house would benefit from some cosmetic updating, giving a new owner the chance to refresh the interiors and add their own style without having to start from scratch.

Outside, there’s a driveway to the front providing off-road parking, while the large rear garden offers plenty of space for relaxing, entertaining and gardening. There are also power sockets to the rear, a useful touch for outdoor projects and garden maintenance. There may be potential to extend the property, subject to the necessary planning permissions and consents.

Location

The property is situated in Fallowfield, with a good choice of everyday amenities close by. Wilmslow Road is nearby with its wide range of shops, cafés, restaurants and other local services, while Platt Fields Park provides a large green space for walks, sport and leisure. The area is also well placed for access to The University of Manchester and other university facilities.

There are a number of schools in the surrounding area, including Wilbraham Primary School, William Hulme's Grammar School and Whalley Range 11-18 High School. School admissions and catchment should be confirmed directly with the relevant schools and Manchester City Council.

Transport links are another benefit, with regular bus services providing connections towards Manchester city centre and surrounding areas. Withington Metrolink is around 0.8 miles away, while Mauldeth Road railway station is also within the wider area for rail connections.

Whether you're taking your first step onto the property ladder or looking for an investment with potential, this home offers a solid starting point with plenty of room to make it your own. Book a viewing and see what you could do with it.

Property Description

A BEAUTIFULLY UPGRADED, READY-TO-MOVE-IN FAMILY HOME, OFFERED WITH NO ONWARD CHAIN!

Purplebricks are delighted to present this stunning three-bedroom modern home, situated within the popular Trinity Point development in Pendlebury, Swinton.

Originally constructed as part of this attractive modern development, the property has benefited from considerable investment, including a stylish newly fitted kitchen, upgraded carpets and fitted wardrobes.

Offering approximately 884 sq ft of accommodation across two floors, this fantastic home is ideal for families, professional couples and buyers seeking contemporary, low-maintenance living.

Ground Floor

The entrance porch provides access to a convenient downstairs WC and the spacious living room, offering an inviting space for relaxing and entertaining.

To the rear is the impressive newly fitted kitchen with adjoining dining area, providing a fantastic setting for family meals and social occasions. French doors allow natural light to flood the room and provide access outside.

First Floor

The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom benefiting from its own private en-suite shower room.

The additional bedrooms provide excellent flexibility for family living, guests or a home office.

Upgraded carpets and fitted wardrobes further enhance the accommodation, while a modern family bathroom completes the first floor.

Location & Development

Situated on the popular Trinity Point development, the property enjoys a convenient residential location within easy reach of Swinton, Prestwich and Manchester City Centre.

The surrounding area offers supermarkets, independent shops, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities, while Clifton Country Park and Drinkwater Park provide excellent outdoor recreational opportunities.

Schools & Transport

The area is well served by local schools, including Summerville Primary School, St John's CE Primary School, St Paul's CE Primary School and All Hallows RC High School.

Excellent transport connections include easy access to the A580 East Lancashire Road, M60 motorway and Swinton railway station, providing convenient links towards Manchester, Salford Quays, MediaCityUK and surrounding areas.

Vacant Possession – No Onward Chain

Offered with vacant possession and no onward chain, this beautifully presented home provides an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a straightforward move.

With its modern layout, substantial upgrades, excellent location and ready-to-move-in condition, this is a property that really does stand out.

EARLY VIEWING IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Situated on the ever-popular Blackberry Point development this immaculately presented family home is ideal for the growing family, and someone looking to really impart their own style on a property.

Externally the communal park area for the estate can be found opposite, perfect for kicking the kids out in the morning and knowing they will be safe in the gated area!

You have off-road parking for multiple vehicles as well as an integral garage, which would be ideal for potential future conversion if extra internal space is needed.

On entering the home you are welcomed into the hallway, with the main living room to the right hand side. Here there is ample seating, as well as a really beautiful bay window nook, where I can see you reading under a lamp (or even for that perfect Christmas tree spot!).

Heading to the rear of the house there is the main heart of the property, which is the open plan kitchen/dining space. Here you can see evenings with the family or parties going late into the night. Three skylights bring plenty of natural light into the space, with French doors leading into the garden. There is an abundance of work surface space, cupboards and integral kitchen white goods, with more than enough room for a dining table, I have seen others with island spaces that fit easily also.

The rear garden is completely walled in, so a brilliant spot for the budding footballer, or really if you just wanted some privacy when you are relaxing in the rare English sun.

Completing the downstairs is the WC (also an added benefit with kids).

Upstairs there are three double bedrooms, with the main bedroom coming with fitted storage and a really lovely en-suite shower room. A spot of tranquillity in any family home! The other bedrooms well-proportioned, and completing the property is the main family bathroom with bath and shower over, WC and sink.

Get in touch today to arrange your viewing. Detached Family Home. New-Build in 2019. Off-Road Parking and Garage. Walled Rear Garden and Park Opposite. Fantastic Local Access

A well located two-bedroom period mid-terrace property combines character features, spacious accommodation and an impressive rear garden.

Occupying an enviable position just a short stroll from the vibrant centre of Didsbury Village, with its excellent selection of bars, restaurants, cafés and transport links, including the Metrolink, this beautifully presented home offers stylish and versatile accommodation throughout.

The property is approached via a lovely front courtyard, enclosed by attractive brick walls with a timber gate providing access, creating a welcoming and private entrance. A secure intercom entry system leads into the property. The extended kitchen is fitted with a range of contemporary base and wall units complemented by quartz worktops and provides ample space for a dining table and chairs, with pleasant views over the courtyard. To the front of the kitchen is a useful utility room and downstairs WC.

Leading through from the kitchen is a spacious dining room with stairs rising to the first floor, access to the cellar and an open aspect into the lounge. The attractive lounge enjoys a beautiful bay window overlooking the rear garden, a feature fireplace and direct access to the outside space.

To the first floor are two well-proportioned double bedrooms and a generous family bathroom fitted with a four-piece white suite. The principal bedroom further benefits from a mezzanine dressing area with fitted wardrobes and an adjoining en-suite bathroom.

Externally, the property boasts a fantastic-sized rear garden, ideal for both entertaining and family living. A paved patio seating area adjoins the property, leading onto a large central lawn bordered by well-stocked flowerbeds on either side. To the rear of the garden is a further area providing space for a timber shed and additional storage.

A rare opportunity to acquire a characterful period home in one of South Manchester's most sought-after locations, within easy reach of Didsbury Village and its fantastic array of amenities. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the charm, space and location on offer. Call now to arrange your appointment.

With its combination of generous accommodation, private outdoor space, off-road parking and attractive canal views, this is a fantastic opportunity to purchase a lovely family home in a sought-after setting.

Early viewing is highly recommended!

McDermott & Co are proud to present this stunning four-bedroom detached family home, occupying a sought-after position on Woodhouses Avenue, Audenshaw. Offering approximately 1,584 sq ft of stylish and versatile accommodation, this impressive home has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout and is ideally suited to modern family living.

Internally briefly comprising a welcoming entrance hallway, spacious lounge with feature bay window, stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and family room, utility room, ground floor WC and a versatile playroom/snug. To the first floor are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en suite shower room, together with a contemporary family bathroom and additional dressing room/bedroom four.

A particular feature of the property is the superb open-plan living space, creating the perfect hub for family life and entertaining. The home is further enhanced by high-quality fixtures and fittings, integrated Neff appliances, plantation shutters, contemporary décor and an abundance of natural light throughout.

Externally, the property benefits from a imprinted concrete driveway providing off-road parking for multiple vehicles. To the rear is a beautifully landscaped private garden featuring a substantial composite decked terrace, artificial lawn, raised planters and a hot tub area, creating an outstanding space for outdoor dining, relaxation and entertaining.

Conveniently positioned close to local amenities, well-regarded schools and excellent transport links, this exceptional home offers the perfect balance of space, style and practicality.

Combining spacious family accommodation, high-quality finishes and superb outdoor living space, this outstanding detached home represents a fantastic opportunity for a wide range of purchasers. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Benefiting from a useful understairs storage area, radiator and neutral décor throughout, the hallway provides access to the principal ground-floor accommodation and creates an excellent first impression of the home. Bright and stylish throughout, the space reflects the high standard of presentation found across the property.

Complemented by wood-effect LTV flooring, full-height textured wall tiling, a radiator and a frosted window providing natural light and ventilation. Beautifully presented throughout, this stylish and practical facility is conveniently positioned off the entrance hallway.

Lounge - 5.28m x 3.18m (17'4 x 10'5) - A stunning and beautifully presented lounge featuring a front-facing bay window with plantation shutters, allowing an abundance of natural light. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, contemporary wall panelling, two decorative chandelier-style light fittings and a modern vertical radiator, the room offers ample space for a range of lounge furniture.

Finished to an exceptional standard throughout, the room enjoys a bright and elegant feel, enhanced by neutral décor and high-quality finishes. Glazed double doors lead through to the dining kitchen, creating an excellent flow for modern family living and entertaining. A superb principal reception room and a particular feature of the home.

Kitchen - 2.97m x 8.36m (9'9 x 27'5) - A stunning open-plan kitchen / dining / family room fitted with a comprehensive range of contemporary shaker-style wall and base units, complemented by quartz work surfaces and a feature quartz central island with breakfast bar seating and additional storage. A particular feature of the kitchen is the range of integrated Neff appliances, including a double oven, built-in microwave and dishwasher there is also a wine cooler and a Belfast sink.

Benefiting from wood-effect LTV flooring, recessed spot lighting and a rear-facing window with plantation shutters, the room enjoys an abundance of natural light throughout. The generous proportions provide ample space for family dining and informal seating, creating the true heart of the home.

Open access leads through to the dining area, whilst the contemporary layout is ideally suited to modern family living and entertaining. Beautifully presented throughout, this impressive space combines practicality, style and high-quality fixtures and fittings.

Dining Room - 3.58m x 5.69m (11'9 x 18'8) - A stunning and beautifully appointed dining room / family room, forming the heart of the home and enjoying an abundance of natural light from a striking roof lantern and extensive glazing overlooking the rear garden. Benefiting from wood-effect LTV flooring, recessed spot lighting, a feature chandelier and contemporary décor throughout, the room provides ample space for a large dining table and additional seating.

A particular feature is the stylish wall-mounted ethanol fire, creating an impressive focal point and adding warmth and ambience to this superb entertaining space. Large glazed doors open directly onto the rear terrace and garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

Beautifully presented throughout, this exceptional room is ideal for family gatherings, formal dining and entertaining alike.

Utility - 2.49m x 1.73m (8'2 x 5'8) - A useful and well-appointed utility room fitted with a range of contemporary high-gloss wall and base units complemented by contrasting work surfaces. Providing space and plumbing for both a washing machine and tumble dryer, the room offers excellent additional storage and workspace.

Further benefits include LTV flooring, under-unit lighting and housing the Ideal boiler, whilst the practical layout creates an ideal laundry and storage area, separate from the main kitchen. Beautifully presented throughout, this functional room complements the high standard of accommodation on offer.

Play Room / Snug - 2.59m x 2.90m (8'6 x 9'6) - A versatile playroom / snug featuring a front-facing window with plantation shutters allowing plenty of natural light. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, recessed spot lighting and a radiator, the room provides flexible accommodation to suit a variety of requirements.

Currently utilised as a playroom, the space is equally suited as a snug, home office, nursery or hobby room. A bright and adaptable room providing valuable additional living space for modern family life.

First Floor Landing - 4.78m x 1.96m (15'8 x 6'5) - A spacious and beautifully presented galleried landing featuring fitted carpeting, contemporary wall panelling, recessed spot lighting and a striking chandelier-style light fitting over the stairwell. Benefiting from a useful built-in storage cupboard and loft access, the landing provides access to all first-floor accommodation.

Flooded with natural light from the feature stairwell window, this elegant space creates an impressive focal point and complements the high standard of finish found throughout the home.

Master Bedroom - 3.02m x 4.24m (9'11 x 13'11) - A spacious and beautifully presented principal bedroom featuring a rear-facing window with plantation shutters allowing plenty of natural light. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, recessed spot lighting, a decorative ceiling light fitting and a radiator, the room offers ample space for a king-size bed and additional bedroom furniture.

A particular feature is the range of fitted wardrobes, providing excellent storage. Finished in neutral tones throughout, this elegant bedroom enjoys a bright and relaxing atmosphere and further benefits from a modern en suite shower room, creating a superb principal suite.

En-Suite - 1.55m x 2.36m (5'1 x 7'9) - A modern en suite fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a walk-in shower enclosure, pedestal wash hand basin and low-level WC. Complemented by fully tiled walls and flooring, recessed spot lighting, a chrome heated towel rail and an extractor fan. Finished in a clean and contemporary style throughout, this bright and practical en suite serves the principal bedroom.

Bedroom Two - 3.12m x 3.25m (10'3 x 10'8) - A spacious double bedroom featuring a front-facing window with plantation shutters allowing an abundance of natural light. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, recessed spot lighting, a decorative ceiling light fitting and a radiator, the room offers ample space for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture.

Beautifully presented throughout, the room is finished in neutral tones and benefits from a stylish feature panelled wall, creating an attractive focal point. A bright and comfortable bedroom, ideal for family members or guests.

Bedroom Three - 2.64m x 4.06m (8'8 x 13'4) - A spacious double bedroom featuring a rear-facing window with plantation shutters allowing plenty of natural light and enjoying a pleasant outlook over the rear garden. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, a decorative chandelier-style light fitting and a radiator, the room offers ample space for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture.

A particular feature is the range of fitted wardrobes and bespoke storage units, providing excellent built-in storage. Beautifully presented throughout, this elegant bedroom combines generous proportions with stylish décor, creating a bright and comfortable space ideal for family members or guests.

Dressing Room / Bedroom Four - 2.03m x 2.46m (6'8 x 8'1) - A versatile room currently utilised as a luxurious dressing room, featuring an extensive range of bespoke fitted wardrobes, hanging space, shelving and display storage, providing exceptional wardrobe and storage solutions. Benefiting from fitted carpeting, a decorative ceiling light fitting, radiator and a front-facing window with plantation shutters allowing plenty of natural light.

Offering excellent flexibility, the room could easily be utilised as a fourth bedroom, nursery, home office or dressing room, depending on individual requirements. Beautifully presented throughout, this practical and stylish room complements the high standard of accommodation found throughout the home.

Bathroom - 2.08m x 3.00m (6'10 x 9'10) - A stylish family bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a panelled bath with dual-head rainfall shower and glazed shower screen, pedestal wash hand basin and low-level WC. Complemented by full-height contemporary tiling, tiled flooring, recessed spot lighting, a chrome heated towel rail and a frosted window with plantation shutters providing natural light and ventilation.

Beautifully presented throughout, this modern bathroom offers a bright and luxurious space, finished to a high standard and ideally suited to modern family living.

Stamp Duty Land Tax - Residential property rates
You usually pay Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) on increasing portions of the property price when you buy residential property, for example a house or flat.
The amount you pay depends on:
• when you bought the property
• how much you paid for it
• whether you’re eligible for relief or an exemption
Rates for a single property
You pay SDLT at these rates if, after buying the property, it is the only residential property you own.

You will usually pay 5% on top of these rates if you own another residential property.

Rates from 1 April 2025
Property or lease premium or transfer value SDLT rate
Up to £125,000 Zero
The next £125,000 (the portion from £125,001 to £250,000) 2%
The next £675,000 (the portion from £250,001 to £925,000) 5%
The next £575,000 (the portion from £925,001 to £1.5 million) 10%
The remaining amount (the portion above £1.5 million) 12%
Example
In April 2025 you buy a house for £295,000. The SDLT you owe will be calculated as follows:
• 0% on the first £125,000 = £0
• 2% on the second £125,000 = £2,500
• 5% on the final £45,000 = £2,250
• total SDLT = £4,750

Brook Lintons is ideally placed for access into Bristol city centre, nearby shops, supermarkets, cafés and local amenities all within easy reach. There are excellent transport links nearby, including access to the A4, A37 and Bristol Temple Meads, while green spaces and parks help give the area a strong community feel.

A fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious home with a superb garden and corner plot setting in a popular Bristol location.

An attractive three-bedroom end of terrace home, situated on a popular street in Brentry, close to the sought-after Primary School, and within easy reach of local shops, parks and transport links

Overview

The entrance hall opens straight into an impressive kitchen/diner, a large and sociable space with ample storage and a built-in breakfast bar, ideal for casual dining or entertaining guests. Flowing on from here, the lounge offers a comfortable, more private space to relax away from the hub of the home. At the other side a bright sun room opens out, perfect for enjoying the garden view year-round. A separate utility room and WC are accessed off the kitchen, adding to the homes practicality.

Upstairs on the first floor, the landing gives access to three well-proportioned bedrooms. Both the master bedroom and second bedroom benefit from fitted wardrobes, while the third bedroom is a versatile space, equally suited to a child's room or a home office. The family bathroom fitted with a three piece suite completes the first floor.

A further staircase rises to the second floor with a versatile loft room, a fantastic bonus space that could easily serve as generous storage or be transformed into a hobby room, home office, or studio.

Like many houses in the area, this property is Laing Easi construction so please check with your mortgage lender prior to viewing.

Outside

A driveway to the front of the property offers comfortable off-street parking for two cars.
To the rear, the garden is a real suntrap, thoughtfully laid out to make the most of the space and light. A generous timber decked terrace runs the width of the house, ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. To one side, a substantial part-covered pergola provides a sheltered spot for a hot tub, complete with a retractable screen, perfect for year-round use.
What really sets this garden apart is its open outlook: with views stretching past the boundary fence, there's a lovely feeling of space and sky that's hard to find.

Location

Brentry has always popular thanks to its sought-after primary school and its proximity to Cribbs Causeway, the motorway network and Southmead Hospital.
There is plenty of open green space to explore - Okebourne Park, Chakeshill Park and the John Repton Hall Estate are a short walk away, whilst Blaise Castle with its acres of parkland & woodland are also nearby.
The area is also set to benefit from exciting upcoming developments, including a new arena and a train station within walking distance.

Yopa Bristol are delighted to present this beautifully extended three-bedroom semi-detached family home, complete with a versatile converted loft room, generous open-plan kitchen/dining/family space and a superb low-maintenance rear garden with a summer house. Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac on the ever-popular Beale Close, this property offers flexible living space, modern finishes and an excellent location close to local amenities, schools and transport links.

There is a Virtual Tour that allows all rooms in the property to be viewed, but in brief:-

From the moment you arrive, the property offers fantastic kerb appeal with off-street parking and a welcoming entrance.

Stepping inside, the cosy front living room provides the perfect retreat, centred around a charming log-burning stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the colder months.

To the rear of the property is the real showstopper—a stunning extension creating a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and family area, ideal for modern living and entertaining. Flooded with natural light, this impressive space is perfect for everything from family meals to hosting friends, with direct access onto the rear garden.

The ground floor also benefits from a separate utility room and a convenient downstairs WC, adding practicality to this already impressive home.

Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms alongside the family bathroom, while the converted loft provides an excellent additional room, currently used as a bedroom. This versatile space would also make an ideal home office, hobby room or teenage retreat (subject to any necessary building regulations and buyer verification).

Outside, the rear garden has been thoughtfully designed for low maintenance, allowing you to enjoy the space all year round without the upkeep. A stylish summer house offers endless possibilities as a home office, gym, bar or relaxing garden retreat.

Location

Beale Close is tucked away within a peaceful residential cul-de-sac in South Bristol, making it an excellent choice for families and commuters alike.

The property is conveniently located close to a range of local shops, supermarkets, cafés and everyday amenities, while nearby Hengrove Leisure Park offers a cinema, restaurants, gym and leisure facilities.

Families are well catered for with several highly regarded primary and secondary schools within easy reach, along with excellent green spaces including Manor Woods Valley, Hengrove Park and nearby countryside walks.

Commuters will appreciate the excellent transport links, with easy access to Bristol City Centre, Bristol Temple Meads, Bristol Airport and the A4174 Ring Road, providing convenient routes to the M32, M4 and M5 motorway networks.

Whether you're looking for your next family home or simply more space to grow, this exceptional property combines modern open-plan living with a fantastic location and is ready to move straight into.

text:
With a south facing garden, garage and driveway, this well presented three bedroom semi-detached villa in the popular residential area of Clermiston offers an appealing family home. Local shops, schools and green spaces are within easy reach, while convenient transport links to Edinburgh city centre and the main road networks are ideal for commuting.

A welcoming hallway with useful storage leads to a well proportioned lounge, where a decorative fireplace creates an attractive focal point and French doors open onto the rear garden, seamlessly connecting the indoor and outdoor spaces. The galley style fitted kitchen features a range of wall and base units, with co-ordinated worktops and tiled splashbacks. A separate utility room provides additional practicality and has direct access to the garden. Upstairs, there are two double bedrooms, one with a built in wardrobe, and a third bedroom with storage that would also make an ideal home office or study. A fully tiled, contemporary bathroom with a white suite, rainfall shower and heated towel rail completes the accommodation. Further benefits include an attic, gas central heating and double glazing.

A lawned front garden provides an inviting approach to the property, while the fully enclosed, south facing rear garden features a lawn and patio area, offering a pleasant setting for outdoor relaxation and dining in the warmer months, with space for children and pets to enjoy. There is a single garage with an up and over door, power, light and water, and a driveway provides off street parking, with further parking available on the street.
